mintAuthority.summary: At Celo block 78972424, CADm issuance uses the V2 Broker and legacy BiPoolManager. The two-day Mento Timelock owns the token, Broker and BiPoolManager and can raise trading limits and configure legacy pool pricing. The separate 4-of-6 migration Safe is not BiPoolManager owner at that pin. Validators is token-authorized, but its current mint function targets registry USDm and only registry EpochManager can invoke it. Celo Governance owns both the Validators proxy and Registry: upgrades or registry reassignment can enable a latent CADm mint path. No Mento Timelock protection is attributed to Celo Governance. D14: issuance is economically unbounded because the token owner can set an arbitrary Broker/minter with no token-level collateral check; the two-day delay does not bound the amount. D29 is not certified because the authorized Validators proxy has separate Celo Governance upgrade authority.

controls.label: Mento Broker - operational CADm swap minter
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, broker() on CADm returned this Broker. Broker swaps call transferIn to burn the incoming Mento stable and transferOut to mint the outgoing stable only through registered exchanges subject to exchange and trading-limit checks.

controls.label: Mento Timelock - CADm token and Broker administrator
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, CADm owner(), token proxy owner, and Broker proxy owner returned this Timelock; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. StableTokenV2 ownership can change broker, validators, and exchange authorization slots, while the proxy role can replace token and Broker mint-critical logic.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized CADm minter slot
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, validators() on CADm returned this proxy and StableTokenV2 admitted it through onlyMinter. The current Validators implementation can mint only Registry USDm to EpochManager and has no generic or CADm-targeting call, so the slot is authorized but cannot currently issue CADm.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators proxy upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner(), Registry owner(), and Registry proxy _getOwner() resolve to Celo Governance. Validators currently mints only Registry USDm to registered EpochManager. Registry setAddressFor is onlyOwner and can replace StableToken and EpochManager; the Validators implementation is separately replaceable by this owner. These mutable target/caller and upgrade paths can authorize CADm issuance without attributing the Mento Timelock delay to Celo Governance.

controls.label: Mento migration Safe - legacy FX pool configuration
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, BiPoolManager 0xc016174b60519bdc24433d4ed2cff6c1efac7881 owner() returns Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not this 4-of-6 Safe. The Safe's getModulesPaginated returns no enabled modules and the guard slot is zero. Verified BiPoolManager source permits owner-only pricing-module, oracle, spread and exchange configuration that determines Broker issuance quotes; these owner-only powers belong to the Timelock at this pin, not the Safe. Broker configureTradingLimit is separately restricted to its owner, also the Mento Timelock. BiPoolManager proxy administration remains the Mento Timelock.

review.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, CADm broker(), owner(), validators(), and exchange() returned the Mento Broker, two-day Mento Timelock, Celo ValidatorsProxy, and zero address respectively. Proxy introspection resolved the current token and Broker implementations and administrators. The Broker is the live swap mint/burn path; the current Validators implementation can only mint Registry USDm, while its Celo-Governance-owned proxy remains a latent upgrade-controlled authorization surface. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Mento Timelock and broad Celo governance bound the live and latent raise paths, the CADm-scoped live adapter covers the full shared reserve continuously, and no named prudential regulator or independent attestor applies. D14/D29 review 2026-10-03 at Celo block 79142378 (hash 0xe5ac3917c420c5f097992356e3a8934c336d354a139b8a1207fe547af3569c6c): owner(), _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolve to Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not the migration Safe; the implementation slot resolves to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Read-only setBroker(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) from that owner succeeds, and mint(chosenRecipient,1e18) from the configured Broker succeeds. Verified setBroker accepts an arbitrary address; onlyMinter gates mint by caller identity and imposes no collateral/deposit check or economic ceiling. The 172800-second Timelock delay does not make arbitrary minter authorization economically bounded. D29 screening confirms MentoGovernor proposer/canceller membership, open execution, Timelock administration, and no such Safe roles; the separately observed canceller 0xe6951c4176aab41097c6f5fe11e9c515b7108acd is not asserted to have mint power. The governor uses the verified lock-escrowed veMENTO contract. However validators() on this token resolves to 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, whose proxy owner is separate Celo Governance 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972: independently replacing this token-authorized implementation is not rooted in MentoGovernor. Current Validators targets registry USDm, not this token; that observation does not close its independent upgrade path. Complete governor-only issuance closure is therefore not certified and no governedIssuance or complete executionScope is authored. This D14 verdict supersedes any earlier raiseable/partially-bounded economic inference; reconciliation and supervision are unchanged.
